messages:
maya (mktg-ops): Quick ops thread — finalizing reg page + recording flow for Monday workshop. Need owners for: reg page copy A/B, Zoom config, post-record transcode + SRT naming, caption/translate plan, and CRM routing.

ben (growth): I can do reg page AB + UTM table. Will push copy variants and the GA/UTM mapping in 45m. Planning 50/50 split.

sasha (content): I'll own the post event sequence (recording email + 3 highlight clips) and draft nurture copy for MQLs.

devon (prod): Zoom checklist: cloud record on, separate audio files, disable auto-transcribe (we'll use our SRT pipeline), meeting passcode, record active speaker. Need host creds.

maya (mktg-ops): I'll share host creds via 1Password. Also let's standardize SRT file pattern — editors keep losing files when names differ.

devon (prod): Proposed SRT pattern:
```
redwood_workshop_2026-04-06_session{session_id}_segment_{hhmmss}.srt
```
Upload path: gs://redwood-event-assets/workshop/2026-04-06/raw/
Transcode output -> gs://redwood-event-assets/workshop/2026-04-06/edits/

transcode-bot: Recording is scheduled: 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Auto-trigger will run transcode job and generate initial SRT (machine). Human QA step required for top clips.

ben (growth): Reg page fields: name, email, company, role, "How did you hear about this?" (short), hidden utm_source + utm_campaign + session_id. CTA test variants: A) "Reserve your seat — live demo" B) "Save your seat + preview". I'll post both copies shortly.

sasha (content): Post-event workflow (0–48h): 0–6h: send recording + TL;DR. 6–24h: 3 highlight clips + captions. 24–48h: on-demand page + CTA to book demo. I'll provide templates and timestamp markers for clips.

alex (sales-ops): CRM mapping: webinar_source = "workshop_apr2026", map utm_campaign, session_id, referral field. Engagement score = attendance_minutes/max_minutes * 100 + poll_bonus. If engagement_score >= 70 and company_size >= 50 => tag workshop_high_intent -> route to SDR queue.

maya (mktg-ops): Who'll own final clip ticketing to editors? Need someone to create GH tickets with timestamps and SRT links.

sasha (content): I'll create the editor tickets and do first QA for the three highlight clips. Design to deliver static frames.

devon (prod): Copyable Zoom settings for ops:
```
- Cloud recording: ON
- Record active speaker + gallery: Active
- Separate audio files for each participant: ON
- Auto-transcribe: OFF
- Require meeting passcode: ON
```

ben (growth): I'll wire the 50/50 split in LaunchDarkly flag and share the rollout key here.

alex (sales-ops): Once Zapier mapping is live, I'll run a dry test lead and confirm CRM tags + routing.

maya (mktg-ops): I'll ping #release-war-room 30m before start for final handoff and host role. Also I'll maintain this thread as single source of truth for ops changes.

sasha (content): Tiny UX ask: add a short checkbox opt-in to receive follow-ups + product updates. Helps compliance & nurture.

maya (mktg-ops): Included. OK team — expect a final checklist doc from me by EOD Friday. Flag any blockers here. :rocket:
